master.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE master CONCEPT DESIGN SHEET, Võ Lâm Hero Defense Phase 1C, arena enemies Waves 5–8. These are design proposals awaiting approval, NOT production sprites or animation assets.
Actual visual references attached: image 1 approved Waves 1–4 concept sheet is the PRIMARY art style/proportion/lighting/camera benchmark; image 2 actual approved production sprites beside Cái Bang at normal 2x desktop scale establishes GAMEPLAY pixel density and scale; images 3 and 4 are approved production atlases for bandit swordsman/archer, STYLE/SCALE REFERENCES ONLY. Do NOT reproduce their atlas grids or animation strips. Make original new enemies that look native to the EXACT SAME game. Do not redesign the existing reference hero or bandits.
STYLE LOCK: detailed crisp 2D CHIBI WUXIA PIXEL ART with ~2.5-head human proportions, enlarged expressive head, short legs/compact torso, warm dark brown/charcoal outlines of the same logical thickness, carefully clustered square-pixel shading and limited harmonious palettes, upper-left warm daylight and tiny grounded contact shadows. Orthographic elevated top-down three-quarter overworld camera, showing head tops/shoulders and front bodies; same elevation in FRONT, BACK, LEFT and RIGHT. Not realistic anatomy, painterly portrait, 3D, isometric, smooth vector, flat side-scroll or ultra-low-detail 8-bit. Enlarged concept views should look like consistent nearest-neighbor enlargements of ~42–46 logical-pixel-tall bodies, not smooth high-res paintings passed through a pixel filter.
COMPOSITION: wide landscape, high resolution. Same warm neutral ivory paper and restrained separators as approved Waves 1–4 sheet. FOUR HORIZONTAL ROWS in order 05 assassin, 06 monk, 07 skeleton swordsman, 08 skeleton archer. Each row: name/English subtitle at left, four complete static full-body views FRONT / BACK / LEFT / RIGHT, ONE separate complete ACTION pose, compact 6-color PALETTE and small weapon close-up, then approximate SCALE comparison of red Cái Bang hero + ochre Bandit Grunt + this row's new enemy on shared feet baseline at equal pixel scale. Leave generous margins/gutters; no cropped skull, hood, staff, blade, bow or quiver, no weapons crossing neighboring figures. Suggested title 'ARENA CREEPS — CONCEPT 05–08'. Small subtitle 'PHASE 1C • CONCEPT ONLY • SCALE APPROXIMATE'. Labels clean and secondary, not a game UI. Both scale-reference figures remain existing designs.
Every enemy's four views MUST depict ONE consistent character with the same costume, accessories, weapon count/design, colors and proportions. FRONT faces down/south, BACK faces up/north, LEFT face points to image's left edge, RIGHT face points to right edge. Keep view labels accurate.
05 'Hắc Y Sát Thủ' / 'Black-Clad Assassin': Slim agile human of about 42 logical-pixel body height, similar height to existing bandit archer, not a tall realistic ninja. Ancient Chinese wuxia dark hood and charcoal/plum short layered martial tunic, wrapped shins/forearms, fitted dark trousers and light soft boots. Lower face covered by dark cloth; narrow focused eyes visible, no glowing full-face mask. Short dark crimson waist sash and small crimson wrist ties, restrained plum edge highlights keep black silhouette readable. EXACTLY TWO short matching Chinese daggers, one in each hand, simple dark steel triangular blades with small bronze guards and crimson-bound handles; no long sword, no extra sheathed third blade, no firearms or elaborate spikes. Knees slightly flexed, narrow sharp silhouette, compact short sash tails. ACTION: one low quick forward dagger lunge with both blades identifiable, communicates speed and precision through body pose, NO afterimage/slash-trail effect assets. Weapon detail: paired short daggers. 6-color charcoal/plum/crimson/skin/steel palette.
06 'Tà Tăng' / 'Corrupted Monk': Broad compact bald human monk, about 46 logical-pixel height, modestly heavier than hero/bandits, never giant boss scale. Large bald round head, stern thick brows, sinister expression. Torn dark oxblood/rust-brown Chinese monastic cross-wrap robes, dark loose trousers, worn cream wraps, heavy cloth shoes, one exposed muscular upper arm. Large dark wooden prayer beads loop around neck with SAME bead size/count convention in all views. ONE thick heavy wooden martial staff with worn iron/brass binding rings and blunt reinforced ends, held in same hand/side throughout; NOT spear, crescent halberd, European mace or monk sword. Purple/red corrupt energy hinted only by tiny dim violet/crimson glints within bead inlays/eyes/staff binding, restrained and attached to character; preserve natural readable cloth colors. ACTION: one powerful grounded two-handed staff strike with bent knees and weight forward. No ground shockwave asset, VFX panel or aura sheet. Weapon detail: reinforced staff and beads. 6-color oxblood/brown/charcoal/walnut/violet/skin palette.
07 'Khô Lâu Kiếm Sĩ' / 'Skeleton Swordsman': Same game-scale chibi undead (~44 logical-pixel height), oversized ivory skull with prominent brow and short readable teeth, pale-green glowing eye sockets, exposed rib cage/forearm/shin bones, chunky readable joints. Remnants of broken ancient CHINESE lamellar armor: tarnished bronze/rust shoulder guards and fragmented dark breastplate around exposed ribs, ragged faded charcoal-teal waistcloth and leg wraps. Strong medium-width warrior silhouette, wider than skeleton archer but not large knight/boss. ONE rusted straight Chinese JIAN sword with small plain brass crossguard/ring pommel, chipped steel edge and rust patches, held in anatomical RIGHT hand consistently (viewer-left FRONT, viewer-right BACK); no European longsword, shield, helmet plume or second sword. ACTION: one decisive diagonal sword slash, bones and armor remain readable, no detached spectral-slash asset or bone-fragment effect panel. Weapon detail: rusted Chinese jian. 6-color aged ivory/warm bone shadow/rust bronze/faded dark teal/pale green/charcoal palette.
08 'Khô Lâu Cung Thủ' / 'Skeleton Archer': Clearly related to row 07: same skull design/brow/short teeth, aged ivory bone palette, joint shapes and weathered charcoal-teal fabric family; about 42 logical-pixel height with thinner ribs/shoulders/limbs and no heavy shoulder plate. Glowing turquoise-blue/green eye sockets distinguish it subtly. Small tattered faded charcoal-teal shoulder scarf and light leather torso remnants, exposed bony arms/shins. ONE decayed gray-brown wooden recurved bow with simple intact string, held consistently in anatomical LEFT hand (viewer-right FRONT, viewer-left BACK); one worn brown QUIVER slung diagonally on back holding 3–4 ancient arrows with faded pale fletching. Bow curve and quiver immediately distinguish it from sword skeleton, preserve both in all relevant views. ACTION: one bow-drawing pose with single nocked arrow, no flying projectile or spectral trail asset. Weapon detail: weathered bow/quiver/ancient arrow. 6-color aged ivory/brown/gray wood/faded charcoal-teal/turquoise/charcoal palette.
APPROXIMATE SCALE: Cái Bang ~44 logical-pixel body, existing Bandit Grunt ~42; assassin ~42, monk ~46, skeleton swordsman ~44, skeleton archer ~42. These are conceptual targets only. Keep the new units close to existing approved human scale; torso width and equipment distinguish classes, not huge size changes. Scales are illustrative, not gameplay screenshots.
Hard limits: ONLY these FOUR new concept designs, existing hero/bandit scale references, their weapons, four static views and ONE action pose each. NO animation sequences, sprite atlas grids, hurt/death strips, production exports, extra enemies, waves 9–20, dungeon creatures, bosses, maps, UI, standalone skills or effects. Every view and weapon fully visible. Original project concept art, do not copy existing commercial-game assets.
